entries.title: Public HTTP error and recovery pages introduced
entries.summary: The public site now replaces the host's plain error response with branded, accessible recovery pages in the Society's green, gold, and vellum visual language. Unknown paths return a genuine HTTP 404 response with search-index protection and useful routes back into the corpus; recoverable application failures receive a coordinated HTTP 500 experience with retry and public-record options. The copy is deliberately informative with a restrained measure of wit. All 75 release tests passed before publication, and the custom-domain 404 was verified after deployment.

changes: Added a branded HTTP 404 page for unknown public paths
Preserved the genuine HTTP 404 status for clients and crawlers
Marked error responses noindex and nofollow
Added clear recovery routes to the frontispiece, Society, and Blogs and Essays
Added coordinated route-level and global HTTP 500 recovery experiences
Added accessible reduced-motion and responsive presentation
Added automated coverage for the rendered 404 response and error fallbacks
